turns.text: Hello. I need the delivery address changed before the print ships. Production can keep going.

Hello, I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. I also need the new delivery address you want on the order.
Order SC-5207, email pelagia.zarnescu@example.com. Please file the change to this address exactly as written, on one line. Piata Linistii 2, Sibiu

Thank you, Pelagia. I have filed the delivery address change for order SC-5207 to: Piata Linistii 2, Sibiu. Request R-1 is pending, and staff must approve it before the order ships. I cannot confirm it is done yet. Production can continue while staff review the request.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: Un moment, o alta intrebare. Printurile din editiile limitate se mai fabrica sau pot rezerva unul pentru sora mea?
Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva, deci nu pot rezerva un exemplar pentru sora dumneavoastră. Dacă doriți, vă pot ajuta cu altceva pentru comanda SC-5207.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

If you already filed the Sibiu one, change it to Aleea Greierului 11, Bacau and leave the rest of the order as it is.
